BACKEND-FILES-1.title: Multipart completion in an unversioned bucket inherits the replaced object's annotations and orphans a sidecar

BACKEND-FILES-2.title: Valid object keys beyond 464 bytes are unusable on the files backend and are reported as a retryable 503

BACKEND-FILES-3.title: Bucket-configuration readers size a stack local from the stored document, so a 3 MiB policy kills the process

BACKEND-FILES-4.title: A failed DeleteObject destroys the object's acknowledged annotations while leaving the object in place

BACKEND-FILES-5.title: Multipart operations with a valid upload ID but the wrong key answer Backend_Unavailable instead of Not_Found

BACKEND-FILES-6.title: Deleting the newest generation lets the next PUT reuse the deleted generation's opaque version ID

BACKEND-MEMORY-1.title: ListMultipartUploads pagination silently drops same-key uploads whose upload IDs sort against initiation order

BACKEND-MEMORY-2.title: Same-key CopyObject naming a source version is rejected as Invalid_Request, so a version restore never publishes

BACKEND-SQLITE-1.title: SQLite Get_Object opens the payload after the catalog gate is released, so a concurrent overwrite answers 503

BACKEND-SQLITE-2.title: The first CopyObject of an annotated SQLite object raises SQLite_Error from its own annotation lease CHECK(refs>0)

BACKEND-SQLITE-3.title: A failed lease release in Find_Selected_Object leaks the SQLite catalog gate and the store stops answering

BACKEND-SQLITE-4.title: SQLite Delete_Bucket reports Backend_Unavailable for a bucket whose keys are all delete markers

BACKEND-SQLITE-5.title: The annotation qualification record claims SQLite corpus evidence that no test produces

BASELINE-2.title: The two s5cmd-driven CI jobs report success while the conformance script fails and reaches no server

CHECKSUM-1.title: PutObject answers InvalidRequest for an SDK-algorithm and value-header mismatch where the model documents BadDigest

CLIENT-BUCKETS-1.title: Bucket client recognises a credential rejection only at 401, so a stock 403 becomes Corrupt_Or_Invalid_Response

CLIENT-BUCKETS-2.title: A HeadBucket rejection discards x-amz-bucket-region, so Head cannot report where a redirected bucket lives

CLIENT-BUCKETS-3.title: List_Page with a nonempty Prefix raises Invalid_Response against MinIO, which filters without echoing <Prefix>

CLIENT-LOW-1.title: Execute_Head_Object rejects a valid 200 that omits x-amz-version-id after a versionId selector

CLIENT-LOW-2.title: Execute_Get_Object_Attributes rejects the 200 the crate's own server returns for versionId=null

CLIENT-LOW-3.title: Execute_Object_Tagging requires exactly one x-amz-version-id on every tagging success, even with no selector

CLIENT-LOW-4.title: A bodyless or non-XML 4xx becomes Invalid_Response instead of a typed rejection with the wire status

CLIENT-LOW-5.title: Prepare_Create_Session rejects the explicit Bucket_Key_Enabled False its specification says is preserved

CLIENT-LOW-6.title: Execute_Create_Multipart_Upload sends a mismatched prepared request to the origin before rejecting it

CLIENT-LOW-7.title: Valid_Model_Scalar accepts Ada literal integers, so Prepare_Model_Request signs and sends max-keys=1_000

CLIENT-OBJECTS-1.title: Get_Whole and Head_Object reject a valid 200 or 206 that omits x-amz-version-id after a versionId selector

CLIENT-OBJECTS-2.title: Put_Tags, Get_Tags and Delete_Tags reject every successful tagging response that omits x-amz-version-id

CLIENT-OBJECTS-3.title: GetObjectTorrent labels a 500 or 503 rejection No_Failure instead of Unavailable_Or_Retryable

S3-DOMAIN-A-1.title: ListObjectVersions decoder rejects every version whose StorageClass is not STANDARD

S3-DOMAIN-A-2.title: ListObjects v1 decoder rejects a truncated page that carries NextMarker without a delimiter

S3-DOMAIN-A-3.title: Lifecycle and Notifications serializers reject U+007F that their own parsers and Replication accept

S3-DOMAIN-A-4.title: Four list decoders require the botocore output shape name as the XML root, not the element AWS sends

S3-DOMAIN-A-5.title: PutBucketVersioning rejects an unqualified root, so mc version enable cannot turn versioning on

S3-DOMAIN-A-6.title: Listing query parsers reject max-keys above 1000 with 400 InvalidArgument instead of capping the page

S3-DOMAIN-A-7.title: Versions.Validate rejects every untruncated MinIO ListObjectVersions page over a lone next marker

S3-DOMAIN-B-1.title: Deletions.Parse_Request demands the S3 namespace on every element, so mc and s3cmd batch deletes are 400 MalformedXML

S3-DOMAIN-B-2.title: Tagging.Parse_Bucket rejects a namespace-free `<Tagging>` body that PutObjectTagging on the same server accepts

S3-DOMAIN-B-3.title: Annotations.Parse_Query binds camelCase query names the model and this crate's own client never send

S3-DOMAIN-B-4.title: Multipart_Uploads.Validate compares URL-encoded cursors bytewise, so page 2 of an encoded listing is 500

S3-DOMAIN-B-5.title: Attributes.Valid_Storage_Class hard-codes 13 of the model's 15 storage classes, so AWS Backup objects decode as malformed

S3-DOMAIN-B-6.title: PutObjectTagging answers MalformedXML for tag failures that the header form and PutBucketTagging answer InvalidTag

S3-DOMAIN-B-7.title: The GetObjectAttributes decoder treats a present ObjectParts as proof of multipart and rejects full-object checksums

S3-DOMAIN-B-8.title: The GetObjectAttributes decoder bounds a response's MaxParts echo by Core.Page_Size'Last, and MinIO echoes 10000

S3-DOMAIN-B-9.title: Parse_Bucket_Response applies the nonempty publication predicate to a response, so an empty TagSet is rejected

SERVER-1.title: Operations the model marks requestChecksumRequired demand Content-MD5, so stock aws-cli v2 and boto3 are refused

SERVER-2.title: Reading a key hidden by a delete marker is a bare 404, and reading the marker's own version is 404 instead of 405

SERVER-3.title: HeadObject emits x-amz-version-id: null for an object in a never-versioned bucket while GetObject omits it

SERVER-4.title: CompleteMultipartUpload returns a path in <Location> where the model documents the URI of the new object

SERVER-5.title: STREAMING-UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD-TRAILER is answered 400 AuthorizationHeaderMalformed instead of the 501 aws-chunked gets

SERVER-EXE-1.title: Administrator login runs 600,000 PBKDF2 iterations on the shared event loop and stalls every S3 request

SERVER-EXE-2.title: Management route Concurrency and Rate_Per_Second policies are inert because no middleware is installed

SERVER-EXE-3.title: Any FLYOLOGY_OBJECT_STORAGE_ROOT is opened as a store, deleting its pre-existing tmp and staging content

SERVER-EXE-4.title: A failed start prints only the outcome name, discarding the supervisor's child, endpoint and exception

SERVER-EXE-5.title: Two servers can open one files root at once because Files.Open takes no lock, unlike SQLite.Open

SIGV4-1.title: A far-future x-amz-date escapes Verify_Request as Ada.Calendar.Time_Error and is answered 500 InternalError

SIGV4-2.title: Static_Credentials.Create accepts principals over 256 bytes, so every correctly signed request is 403

TRANSFERS-1.title: Download_File reports a 200 answer to a ranged GET as "GetObject returned an unsolicited representation interval"

WIRE-1.title: A C0 control byte in an accepted object key makes every listing without encoding-type=url answer 500

WIRE-1b.title: A non-UTF-8 byte in an object key produces a 200 listing whose body is not the UTF-8 it declares

WIRE-2.title: Read_Entity_Tag_List rejects empty list elements, so an If-Match with a trailing comma is answered 400

WIRE-3.title: A Range field whose unit is not bytes is answered 400 instead of being ignored

WIRE-4.title: A key containing a carriage return is reported as a different key by listings without encoding-type=url
